reviewScope.statement: Complete draft, decision and draft-checks documents read. Independent semantic review against freshly opened official substantive bodies. Existing related route definitions and English index checked; not a fresh complete reread of all linked article bodies.

primaryEvidence.assessment: Google documents computer-based calendar-specific Trash, 30 days subject to permanent removal, and sufficient event-edit permission. This-and-following deletion is excluded from Trash; other recurring deletions can restore grouped instances. Creator restoration requires renewed guest responses and a booked room may be unavailable. Draft preserves these limits.

Apple describes earlier calendar-version replacement across devices, saving the current version first, possible loss of recent changes and backup advice. Sharing is erased. Its specific recent-cancellation and recent-creation cases do not resend the respective messages. Draft accurately flags these effects and directs readers to those details before acting.

semanticChecks.topic: Provider versus Cloud and local storage
semanticChecks.detail: Google/iCloud controls remain explicitly provider-labelled. Device-only calendars, Outlook, other providers and Cloud sharing data are outside the established procedures. No Cloud restore or universal recovery guarantee.
Ownership, identity, date and provider presence are checked before restore. Lost shared access is distinct from deletion. No account reset, reimport or permanent-deletion diagnostic instruction.
Permanent This-and-following exception, grouped recurring restoration, renewed RSVPs and uncertain resource availability all retained.
Replacement, recent changes, saved current version, backup and erased sharing precede archive selection. No selected-event or unchanged-invitation promise.

Decision is an earlier preparation-stage document; draft-checks explicitly reconciles its working slug to the single current proposed canonical. Its earlier no-draft statement is historical, not a second proposed page.

relatedEvidence.scope: Definition start lines and English index membership verified, not runtime navigation.

optionalReaderPolish.suggestion: Optionally summarize the two documented notification cases directly for readers: cancellation messages are not resent for recently cancelled events contained in the restored version; invitations are not resent for recently created events, which invitees may still see. Current concise referral to Apple is already truthful and is not a publication blocker.

limits: No draft mutation or source integration.
No account, restoration, API write, native runtime, build or deployment action.
Source inspection and official documentation do not establish released Cloud binary behavior or successful recovery for an individual account.
Independent bounded factual/editorial review, not legal or native-speaker certification.
Linked provider pages and media beyond the two specified complete extracted bodies were not treated as read.
